propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module couples byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, rotation, and comment identity; the decomposition must extract three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) while preserving one public facade and exact serialization behavior
Production code mutates bindings returned by shallow all_bindings() query; narrow mutation seams must be added so lifecycle operations no longer require direct entry mutation

Durable tombstone retirement completions must be idempotent, run post-staleness-gate but before remote Jira observation, only trigger when all three identities (tombstone, forward, reverse) agree, and be revocable only by explicit unretire
Automatic liveness signals (absent 404 count, clear_absent, confirm) must never resurrect a tombstoned identity or override explicit retirement intent
Load, check, dry-run, preview, and selection operations must perform zero recovery writes; only exclusive write-bearing operations after validation may repair interrupted retirements
Unknown fields, indent=2, sorted keys, trailing newlines, and byte/HEAD idempotency must survive the refactor; existing five-file selective publication and rotation-before-live ordering preserved
